name: GroMo
long_description: GroMo (YC W21) is building India's largest financial products distribution company. GroMo has built a network of 1.2 million agents on its platform. GroMo has built a tech-enabled social commerce platform that helps agents not only improve access to better financial products for consumers, but also bridge the financial literacy gap by helping them choose the right offerings. Currently, GroMo is distributing a broad spectrum of 100+ financial products across Insurance, Investments, Credit Cards, Loans, Saving & Demat accounts, etc. from brands such as IDFC Bank, Jupiter Money, Axis Bank, Freecharge, etc.
one_liner: App for independent agents to sell financial products in India

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Ankit is the Founder and CEO of GroMo. He is a serial entrepreneur with failures and successful exits. Prior to GroMo, he was Founding Member and COO of Unicommerce (listed on NSE in India), and co-founder of Priyaasi (acquired by Mensa Brands). He graduated from IIT Delhi and has 15+ years of experience in a hedge fund, e-commerce, SaaS, fintech.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I am a co-founder at GroMo. Prior to GroMo, I worked with Snapdeal and Housing.com (both backed by Softbank) in various roles across Strategy, and Business Intelligence. I have also worked at Oracle as a Software Engineer. I am interested in emerging trends in Fintech both in India and across the world. I am an avid basketball follower and a big Golden State Warrior fan.
